notes.title: Tides of the Endless: Rising Tide Demo is Now Live!
notes.notes:
[h2]🌊 [i]Tides of the Endless: [/i]Rising Tide Demo is Now Live![/h2][p align="start"]Dear players, thank you so much for your patience!
We are a brand-new indie team. Although we faced many challenges during development, with passion and persistence we’ve finally reached this important milestone.[/p][p align="start"]Today, the [b]Tides of the Endless: [/b]Rising Tide[b] Demo[/b] is officially available!
Here’s what you can experience in this version:[/p][h3]🔓 Demo Content[/h3][olist][*][p][b]3 Mechs[/b] – freely switch between different mechs at any time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]4 Dimensional Worlds[/b] – explore the early dimensional stages and discover the world.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Forging System[/b] – upgrade and adjust equipment stats through crafting.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Set System[/b] – combine different gear slots to unlock \[Mechanism Gem] effects.[/p][/*][*][p][b]4 Battlefields[/b] – challenge various battlefields and obtain powerful loot.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multiple Gear Rarities[/b] – \[White], \[Blue], \[Green], \[Yellow].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Star Chart System[/b] – customize your build with unique progression paths.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Destiny Disk System[/b] – freely combine destiny disks to enhance your build.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Equipment Crafting System[/b] – any gear that has dropped can be recreated through crafting.[/p][/*][*][p][b]And much more[/b] – hidden surprises await![/p][/*][/olist][h3]🔧 Ongoing Updates[/h3][list][*][p]This Demo is an early-stage build, and we will keep improving it based on your feedback.[/p][/*][*][p][b]We plan to update at least once every 2 days[/b], adding more content and optimizations.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🙌 Thank You[/h3][p align="start"]We are a small passionate team, aiming to create a fast-paced and exciting ARPG experience.
We hope this Demo shows you the fun and intensity we want to deliver.[/p][h3]📢 Join Us[/h3][p align="start"]👉 Join our [url="https://discord.gg/RCEqadNMaq"][b]Official Discord Community[/b][/url] to chat directly with the developers and share feedback.
👉 Don’t forget to [b]add the game to your Wishlist[/b] to stay updated on future releases![/p]

notes.title: Update Notes Version v0.10.7.22 (July 22, 2025)
notes.notes:
[p][b]【Major Update Notes】[/b][/p][p][b]Active Skill System Overhaul[/b]
Each mech's active skills have been changed from 4 fixed skills to 2 freely swappable ones, greatly increasing build flexibility.[/p][p][b]Starmap Gem Upgrade Optimization[/b]
Starmap gems can now be upgraded more intuitively through direct editing, improving ease of use.[/p][p][b]Fusion Value Mechanic Adjustment[/b]
Before reaching 400 Fusion Value, all world monsters will no longer generate ground-based lingering debuffs, reducing early-game combat pressure.[/p][p][b]New In-Game Guides[/b]
Additional tutorials and system guides have been added to help both new and returning players understand core mechanics more quickly.[/p][p][b]Lowered Starmap Unlock Requirement[/b]
The requirement to fully unlock the starmap has been reduced from 400 Fusion Value to 200.[/p][p][b]Visual Enhancements[/b]
Removed certain blood effects in maps that interfered with camera visibility, improving visual clarity and combat readability.[/p][p][b]Battlefield Structure Simplification[/b]
The number of battlefield stages has been streamlined from 8 to 4, enhancing overall pacing and stage quality.[/p][p][b]Energy Tower Bug Fix[/b]
Fixed an issue where Energy Tower layers could exceed 100 floors abnormally.[/p]

notes.title: Demo coming soon
notes.notes:
[p][b]Thank you so much for your patience.[/b]
We know it’s been a long wait.[/p][p]We’re a new and passionate team, and this is our very first time sharing something with players. During development, especially in testing, we made a lot of changes—sometimes more than we expected—because we genuinely want to deliver the best possible experience to you.[/p][p][i]Tides of the Endless[/i] is a project we’ve poured our hearts into, and the upcoming [b]demo will be our first real step toward the world[/b] we want to share with all of you.[/p][p]Thank you for being here with us.
We truly hope you enjoy what we’ve been building.[/p]
